messages.subject: Final expert report - Ashfield/Marwick MD-450 failures
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

My final report is attached, signed with the statement of truth. Conclusions unchanged from the preliminary findings: the failures were caused by an undersized output bearing and inadequate case-hardening of the bevel pinion - both manufacturing defects. I deal expressly with and reject Marwick's misalignment / overloading / maintenance points; the records don't support them.

The calculated L10 bearing life at rated load (~5,800 hours) matches the six-to-nine-month in-service failures very closely.

Regards
Alan Renshaw
Renshaw Drive Engineering Consultants
